Q9029.reason: Water is hypotonic and can be absorbed through the bladder wall, causing electrolyte disturbance such as hyponatraemia, so sterile saline is used instead.

Q9030.reason: The son's rights had not vested through knowledge, assent or reliance before the owner and landscaper modified the contract, so the modification is effective against him.

Q9031.reason: Under UCC 2-210 and 9-406, a general ban on assignment does not stop assignment of the right to receive payment unless it specifically says so.
